main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual move in the short direction (return minus coin drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, same-day cases clustered

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of cases above median forecast size minus at/below median

decided_by: t between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: cases are short bets (forecast fall of >= 2 points from its lowest short level since the last bet, reset at 0) on every bar (1-bar grid) with a next bar in the window; larger cases are those with size strictly above the median, smaller those at or below it; the t clusters cases by UTC day; the plan's minimum counts give 'not observable'.
